name: NovaTech Gaming
description: Innovating esports and gaming hardware for peak performance.
story: NovaTech Gaming has been a major player in the esports scene for over a decade, providing cutting-edge peripherals and hardware. Recognizing the parallels between virtual and real-world competition, they are expanding into motorsport to showcase their technology under extreme conditions. NovaTech seeks a team that embodies innovation, precision, and a relentless pursuit of victory.
